measured_or_reported_inputs.normalization_role: Exposed fitted diagnostic; not a scalar charge or prediction

measurement_chain: SQUID voltage records relative particle/pickup-coil motion; magnetic calibration uses inductance, reciprocity, estimated mass and resonance.
Photodiode records mass passages; three equal source masses link passage phase to rotor angle.
Published processing subtracts fitted ringdown, shifts phase, selects integer drive cycles and applies oscillator transfer/calibration.
Platform gravitational response is discussed as a possible contribution to the fitted force-normalization mismatch.
source_limits: Mode damping and frequency can depend on amplitudes of other modes; quoted high-amplitude ringdown is a lower bound, not exact raw-record damping.
Printed Supplement E bandwidth df=Q/f has inverse-frequency dimensions; retain source wording and independently derive any bandwidth convention used.
Printed exponential exponent uses plus t/tau_fit; do not silently assume the fitted parameter sign.
Available raw-file header names demodulators, but does not identify receiver/source wiring, lock-in filter settings, or platform acceleration.
A low-frequency support resonance and a small test/platform mass ratio alone do not bound all transfer corrections near a high-Q sensor resonance.
